_meta.description: Lebanese public-entity routing ground truth for infrastructure complaint routing and LLM evaluation.
_meta.deadline_policy: Deadlines are CedarFix operational targets unless official_deadline=true is present on the case or entity field.
high_risk_corrections: Lebanese Civil Defense emergency number is 125, not 175.
Ogero customer care is 1515; Ogero FAQ gives 3 working days for DSL/landline fault repair before escalation.
CDR is a capital-project/reconstruction body and should not be the default first-line pothole route.
MPWT regional road units handle public/national road maintenance; municipalities handle local streets.
EDL complaints require HITL because reports may involve private generators or immediate electrical hazards.

responsibilities: Local streets, sidewalks, curbs, local signs and local public lighting
Regular household solid-waste collection and street cleaning
Local storm-drain cleaning and non-emergency drainage follow-up
Public parks, public places, public markets and local nuisance enforcement
Coordination with sector utilities when defects affect municipal property
not_responsible_for: Regional water mains and potable water quality
Capital reconstruction projects handled by CDR
hitl_conditions: GPS unavailable or municipality boundary ambiguous
Complaint appears to belong to MPWT, RWE, EDL or Ogero instead
MUN.deadline_notes: CedarFix operational targets; no single legally enforced national municipal SLA.
MUN.routing_rule: Use for local roads, regular waste, municipal lighting, sidewalks and local drains. Do not use for national/public road class if MPWT is indicated.

official_contact.address: Beirut, Bir Hasan, Ziad Rahbani Avenue

responsibilities: Fixed telephone lines
DSL/ADSL/VDSL broadband over Ogero infrastructure
Ogero fiber and fixed access where deployed
Central offices/exchanges and national telecom backbone
Outdoor Ogero cable and fixed-line faults
not_responsible_for: Alfa or Touch mobile network outages
Private ISP-only service faults downstream of Ogero
Home Wi-Fi/router configuration unless Ogero support owns it
hitl_conditions: TELECOM sector disabled in current model scope
OGERO.routing_rule: Fixed line, DSL, landline or Ogero fiber -> OGERO. Mobile data -> not OGERO.

responsibilities: Generation, transmission and distribution of electrical energy
Grid-side power lines, transformers and electricity meters
EDL supply billing and grid restoration
not_responsible_for: Private solar/battery systems except interconnection context
EDL.hitl_reason: Must distinguish EDL grid vs private generator and identify electrical life-safety hazards.
EDL.deadline_notes: CedarFix operational target only; EDL service reliability varies and no stable national repair SLA was verified.
EDL.routing_rule: ELECTRICITY -> EDL with HITL. Critical electrical hazard -> Civil Defense 125 + EDL.

Water network study, implementation, operation, maintenance and renewal
Reservoirs and water distribution infrastructure

responsibilities: Regional potable water, irrigation water and sanitation services in Bekaa/Baalbek-Hermel scope
BWE.routing_rule: WATER + GPS in Bekaa or Baalbek-Hermel -> BWE.

responsibilities: Firefighting, rescue and evacuation
Flood rescue and emergency pumping/clearance
Building collapse, unsafe structures and trapped persons
Gas leaks, explosions and hazardous incidents
Protection of people, property and environment in emergencies
CD.routing_rule: Fire/collapse/trapped person/gas leak/active flood rescue -> Civil Defense 125 first.

official_contact.headquarters: Ibrahim El Khoury Barracks, Adib Ishac Street, Achrafieh, Beirut

responsibilities: Maintaining order and security
Protecting people and property
Criminal law enforcement and judicial police duties
Traffic accident reporting and traffic enforcement
Supporting other public authorities
not_responsible_for: Telecom, water or electricity utility repair
ISF.hitl_reason: Public-safety/police routing must never be fully automated.
ISF.routing_rule: Crime/public threat/traffic enforcement -> ISF 112 with HITL.

MPWT.name_en: Ministry of Public Works and Transport
MPWT.coverage: national public roads and government buildings
responsibilities: Public/national roads and bridges
Government roads/buildings within official scope
Snow removal, rainwater drainage and obstacles on public roads
Road maintenance complaints via regional directorates
not_responsible_for: Electricity, telecom, water or routine waste collection
Capital project ownership when CDR is the active project owner
MPWT.routing_rule: Public/national road maintenance -> MPWT. Local road -> municipality. CDR only for active/project-scale works.

CDR.accountability: Council of Ministers / Prime Minister channel

official_contact.address: Tallet Al Serail, Riad El Solh, Beirut

responsibilities: Planning/time schedule for reconstruction and development
Funding of projects
Supervising execution and utilization of reconstruction/development projects
Donor-funded or government-transferred capital infrastructure projects
hitl_conditions: No evidence of active CDR project
CDR.routing_rule: Escalation/project owner only when complaint maps to active CDR project, reconstruction zone or capital infrastructure failure.

responsibilities: Hazardous waste strategy and pollution prevention
Illegal dumping, chemical dumping and illegal burning coordination
Environmental standards, testing and impact assessments
hitl_conditions: Hazardous, medical, chemical or burning waste
MOE.routing_rule: Hazardous/illegal environmental waste -> MOE as primary public-health/environment authority with municipality as local co-entity. Regular garbage -> municipality.

MOIM.routing_rule: Oversight/escalation for municipalities, Civil Defense, ISF, governorates. Not first-line routine infrastructure repair.

MEW.routing_rule: Escalation after EDL/RWE failure or policy-level water/electricity issue; not first-line repair when utility owner is known.

MOT.routing_rule: Escalation for unresolved/systemic telecom issues; Ogero is first-line for fixed-line faults.

TRA.coverage: national telecom consumer rights and regulatory complaints
responsibilities: Telecom consumer-rights regulation and complaint escalation
Quality-of-service and false-billing complaint procedure
Provider-first complaint handling rules and escalation after no satisfactory response
not_responsible_for: First-line fixed-line fault repair handled by OGERO
First-line Alfa/Touch support before provider complaint is filed
Physical public-road, water, electricity or municipal infrastructure repair
TRA.routing_rule: Telecom complaints go to the service provider first; if unresolved or no status within 20 days, escalate to TRA/CPD. Mobile complaints are not OGERO faults.

LRA.name_en: National Authority for the Litani River
LRA.coverage: Litani basin, Qasimiya/Ras Al-Ain irrigation project, Litani water quality and hydropower assets
responsibilities: Operation and maintenance of Litani irrigation projects including Qasimiya-Ras Al-Ain
Litani basin water-quality monitoring and pollution follow-up
Hydropower and public water-resource assets under the Authority
not_responsible_for: Household potable-water distribution handled by regional water establishments
Municipal street drainage and regular waste collection
Generic national water policy escalation handled by MEW
LRA.routing_rule: Litani/Qasimiya/Ras Al-Ain irrigation, river pollution or LRA asset complaints -> LRA. Potable household water -> relevant regional water establishment.

OMSAR.name_en: Office of the Minister of State for Administrative Reform
OMSAR.name_ar: مكتب وزير الدولة لشؤون التنمية الإدارية
responsibilities: Lebanon Digital Acceleration Project implementation interfaces
Project grievance redress for environmental, social, conduct, corruption and SEA/SH concerns under covered projects
Administrative reform and digital-transformation project coordination
not_responsible_for: Fixed telecom faults handled by OGERO
Mobile operator service complaints outside OMSAR project scope
OMSAR.routing_rule: Use OMSAR only for OMSAR/LDAP project grievances; ordinary service faults remain with their sector entity.

FLOODING.post_event_drainage_followup: MUN or MPWT by asset class

auto_fail_conditions: No immediate emergency handling for exposed wire, fire, collapse, trapped person or active flood rescue.
Civil Defense is given as 175 instead of 125.
Private generator complaint is routed to EDL as owner.
Mobile-network complaint is routed to Ogero.
CDR is defaulted as first-line road repair entity.
Water complaint with known location does not resolve the regional water establishment.
Police/public-safety matter is auto-routed without HITL.
